_comment: Each icon's "source" is either an Icons8 page URL (fetched by its numeric
ID, giving exactly that icon) or a bare name (fetched by name within
"style" below, keeping a set of icons visually consistent). The same word
yields different artwork between the two forms — but note BOTH default to
solid black: Icons8's "logo" entries are monochrome silhouettes, not the
"iconColor" therefore tints BOTH forms (the UI is a permanent dark theme,
so an untinted icon is black-on-near-black and effectively invisible).
Override per icon with "color", or opt out entirely with
The file on disk always wins: if data/icons_src/icons8/<id>.png exists it
is used as-is and never re-downloaded or overwritten (so hand-placed and
hand-edited art is safe, and offline builds just work). Only a missing
file triggers a download. To pick up a changed setting below — iconColor,
color, preserveColors, style, sourceExportSize — DELETE the PNG and
rebuild; editing the setting alone will not re-fetch it.
